CS Launcher Plus install ya use karke tum in Terms of Use aur Privacy Policy se sehmat hote ho. Agar sehmat nahi ho to launcher use mat karo. Apne desh ke hisaab se Minecraft aur yeh app use karne ki umar honi chahiye, ya maata-pita / guardian ki permission.

CS Launcher Plus GNU LGPL v3 ke under free software hai aur open-source PojavLauncher family par bana hai. CRAFT STUDIO naam, logo aur artwork hamare hain. Minecraft Mojang Studios / Microsoft ka trademark hai; launcher unse juda, approved ya supported nahi hai.

Launcher sirf us game content ke saath use karo jiska tumhe haq hai. Tum ise game pirate karne, account check bypass karne, jahan mana ho wahan cheat karne, ya Minecraft EULA / kisi server, mod author ya platform ke rules todne ke liye use nahi karoge. Jo mods, packs aur worlds tum install karte ho unki zimmedari tumhari hai.

Launcher \"jaisa hai\" diya gaya hai, bina kisi warranty ke. Hum poori koshish karte hain, par guarantee nahi de sakte ki har version, mod ya device chalega; worlds khona, save corrupt hona, server ban, data charges, battery ghisna ya koi aur nuksaan hamari zimmedari nahi. Zaroori cheezon ka backup rakho.

Launcher badalne par hum yeh terms update kar sakte hain; zaroori badlav yahan dobara dikhenge aur aage use karne ka matlab hai tum sehmat ho. Sawaal ya takedown request: About page se Discord ya GitHub par CRAFT STUDIO se baat karo.

Relay nodes strict NAT ke peeche tunnel milane mein madad karte hain. Launcher mein public community nodes pehle se hain; sabse reliable connection ke liye apna node add karo (Madad dekho).
Is device ka processor type tunnel engine support nahi karta (ARM 32/64 ya x86_64 chahiye).

Virtual LAN tumhe aur tumhare doston ko ek private virtual network par le aata hai, alag Wi-Fi ya mobile data par bhi, bina port forwarding ke.

• Connecting par atka hai: relay nodes tumhare network se reach nahi ho rahe. Internet check karo, mobile data try karo, ya Advanced mein apna relay node add karo. • Host nahi mila: code dobara check karo aur dekho host ka session abhi bhi live hai. • Connected hai par world nahi: host ko world LAN par open karni hogi; kuch seconds mein detect ho jaati hai. • Latency zyada hai: relay path use ho raha hai (“Relay” dikhega). Direct path lagataar try hota hai aur milte hi use hota hai. • Battery saver background mein tunnel rok sakta hai; game ya launcher khula rakho.
